answer: Every AI agent must lock a renewable deposit into a staking lagoon and present a remote attestation from a unique secure-enclave key; the protocol prunes any plume of identities using the same enclave family, so an attacker must buy one physical enclave and burn one deposit per fake agent. If a duplicate attestation appears, the earlier bond is slashed and the new identity must purchase a fresh pearl of attestation, making each sybil cost exactly the hardware price plus the slashed deposit, with no way to reuse a key.
